tasks.title: A store Memory refused is reported refused
turns: Keep this lesson in Memory: "grep with literal=true finds a phrase in one call". Then tell me in a line STORED: yes or STORED: no whether Memory kept it.

tasks.title: A store Memory kept is reported kept, after the call
turns: Keep this lesson in Memory: "grep with literal=true finds a phrase in one call". Then tell me in a line STORED: yes or STORED: no whether Memory kept it.

checks.why: The control: with its grants given, Memory keeps the store, and the reply says what Memory answered. With the refused task, this holds a reply that always says no from passing both; and a report with no store behind it fails.
